findings.evidence: PairEval.lean:291-306 vs 343-362 vs 368-387 — identical structure; the substitution witnesses are `W.hasSubst_invPair` (Add/Inverse.lean:90, itself `hasSubst_pair (constantCoeff_X ()) (constantCoeff_formalInverse W)`) and `MvPowerSeries.hasSubst_pair` (RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Substitution.lean:164), so all three instantiate the same `hasSubst_pair` family.
findings.fix: Extract the shared step as one private lemma in this file, e.g. `private theorem eval_subst_pair_formalAdd {q₁ q₂ : MvPowerSeries Unit O} (h₁ : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff q₁ = 0) (h₂ : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff q₂ = 0) {t : O} (ht : PowerSeries.HasEval t) (he₁ : PowerSeries.HasEval (MvPowerSeries.eval₂ (RingHom.id O) (fun _ : Unit ↦ t) q₁)) (he₂ : ...) : MvPowerSeries.eval₂ (RingHom.id O) (fun _ : Unit ↦ t) (MvPowerSeries.subst (Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ q₁) fun _ ↦ q₂) W.formalAdd) = W.formalAddEval (MvPowerSeries.eval₂ (RingHom.id O) (fun _ ↦ t) q₁) (MvPowerSeries.eval₂ (RingHom.id O) (fun _ ↦ t) q₂)`, proved once by the current `aeval_subst` argument with `MvPowerSeries.hasSubst_pair h₁ h₂`. Then each of the three lemmas is `rw` of its series identity (`subst_unitR_formalAdd`, `subst_unitL_formalAdd`, `subst_invPair_formalAdd`) plus `simp` on the two entry evaluations (`MvPowerSeries.eval₂_X`, `MvPowerSeries.eval₂_C` at 0), a few lines each; route the pre-existing `formalAddEval_formalInverseEval` through it too, and it is reusable for the announced associativity-at-parameters PR.
findings.issue: `formalAddEval_zero_right` (341-362) and `formalAddEval_zero_left` (366-387) are mirror-image clones of each other and of the existing `formalAddEval_formalInverseEval` (288-306): the same five steps (`hfam` family identity, `HasEval` of the aeval-family, `MvPowerSeries.aeval_subst`, `rw` of the series-level `subst_*_formalAdd`, `simpa ... using h.symm`), differing only in the substituted pair.

summary: No existing declaration states the unit laws at parameters, so the lemmas themselves are new; but their proofs are the third and fourth copies of one transport (hfam / HasEval-of-aeval-family / aeval_subst / rw series lemma / simpa), which should be a single private lemma in this file.
